name: Mahren Skyseer
summary: At Camp Taurajo, proven hunters are sent east to Mahren Skyseer. Jorn Skyseer sends them to his sister to learn how to track along the Barrens shore.

sections.title: A Hunt Beyond the Plains
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Jorn Skyseer tests hunters against the dangerous beasts of the southern Barrens. Once they prove themselves on the red plains, he sends them beyond dry earth and open savanna. A tracker must learn to follow prey through swamps, over sheer crags, and beside the crashing waves of the Great Sea.

sections.title: The Eastern Shore
sections.body: Mahren Skyseer keeps a camp far east along the coast. Jorn studies thunderhawks and plains stalkers, while his sister follows creatures that live in the salt spray. Reaching her means crossing dangerous ground. Kul Tiras marines and Theramore expedition forces hold fortified outposts and watchtowers across the coastal lowlands.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Mahren Skyseer?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer sends you from Camp Taurajo after you complete his hunt for the thunderhawks.
Mahren Skyseer camps along the Barrens' eastern coast, south of Ratchet, near coastal wildlife and Theramore troops.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i need to find mahren
faq.answer: You travel from Jorn Skyseer's hunting trials at Camp Taurajo to Mahren's coastal hunts for sea creatures.

faq.q: Why does Jorn send hunters to Mahren?
aliases: why does jorn send me to his sister
faq.answer: Jorn believes a hunter must master every environment, including the sea. His sister Mahren tracks and confronts aquatic beasts, and can teach you.

faq.q: What dangers lie along the way to Mahren?
faq.answer: Theramore and Kul Tiras expedition forces occupy the eastern coast, alongside aggressive coastal raptors and marine predators.

faq.q: What comes after finding Mahren Skyseer?
faq.answer: After you introduce yourself and earn her trust, Mahren sends you to track Isha Awak, a massive, ferocious sea creature haunting the waters.

angles.text: As a hunter, you go from stalking savanna game to pursuing fierce aquatic beasts under seasoned tauren stalkers' guidance.
As a tauren, you follow the Skyseer siblings' hunting traditions and face trials across every ecosystem as a child of the Earth Mother.
As a member of the Horde, you travel to the eastern coast, close to hostile Alliance footholds spreading from Theramore.
